title: Bipartite
summary: BIP'ARTITE, adjective [Latin bis, twice, and partitus, divided.] 1. Having two correspondent parts, as a legal contract or writing, one for each party. 2. In botany, divided into two parts to the base

inlines.v: BIP'ARTITE, adjective [Latin bis, twice, and partitus, divided.] 1. Having two correspondent parts, as a legal contract or writing, one for each party. 2. In botany, divided into two parts to the base, as a leaf.
